anytime_td.method: standardized logistic regression + held-out sigmoid calibration

passing_td.method: standardized logistic regression + held-out sigmoid calibration

passing_yards.method: histogram gradient boosting + held-out absolute-residual intervals

receiving_yards.method: histogram gradient boosting + held-out absolute-residual intervals

rushing_yards.method: histogram gradient boosting + held-out absolute-residual intervals

scoring.method: histogram gradient boosting + held-out absolute-residual intervals

d9dc5fc3d2b9c070.notes: Player estimates are conditional on appearing in the game, not an availability model. Anytime TD means rushing/receiving TD; passing TD is a separate QB event. Ranges target 80% coverage, not guarantees.

period_trends.methodology: Current-season completed prior-week games. Quarter scores reconcile with final scores. Halves exclude OT. EPA uses pass/run plays. These are descriptive averages, not quarter forecasts.

validation.policy: Fixed configurations; fit 2018–2023, calibrate 2024, test 2025. Test-year features use only earlier games. This is a retrospective development benchmark, not a prospective live record.
